name: Blade
role: melee striker: the party's damage, paid for in Defense
description: Two swords or one great one, and Mail instead of a shield. The Blade stands in the front row and turns every turn into damage: a hundred light cuts that fill the Momentum bar, or one heavy swing that decides the fight.

schools.name: Iron Dance
schools.philosophy: Dual-wield, light 800-weight strikes, many hits. Every strike is a step; the dance ends when the Momentum bar is full.

schools.name: Executioner
schools.philosophy: Two-handed heavy strikes, execute thresholds and crits. One swing, decided before it starts.

schools.name: Bloodletter
schools.philosophy: Bleed, lifesteal and berserk at low HP. Blood out is blood in: the sustain school and the solo Blade's school.

starterKitOptions.name: Greatsword
starterKitOptions.description: A Copper Greatsword in both hands instead of the longsword and dagger: heavy swings, Cleave and the Executioner school.

aiRuleDefault: IF self HP < 30% THEN item small hp potion on self; IF enemy status bleed THEN twin cut on weakest enemy; ELSE open vein on front enemy

visual.notes: An X silhouette: two hilts crossed above the shoulders, or one long two-hander diagonal; a single spaulder, bare forearms, no shield.

pros: Highest sustained single-target damage of the four
Two tempos: 800-weight dual strikes or 1,400-weight executes
Bloodletter sustain clears floors without potions
cons: Mail is weak to Blunt and there is no shield
No ranged answer: a back-row spitter is untouchable until the front row falls
Two weapons wear twice as fast as one
